content:
Here's a concept for a retro-styled 3D game:

Title: "Neon Courier"

Gameplay Concept:
You're a motorcycle courier in a stylized 1980s cyberpunk city, delivering packages across a neon-lit urban landscape. The game would combine elements of:
- Time-based delivery missions
- Obstacle navigation
- Simple combat/evasion mechanics

Core Gameplay Loop:
- Accept delivery missions from a central hub
- Navigate through a procedurally generated city with multiple routes
- Dodge traffic, police, and rival courier gangs
- Upgrade your motorcycle and equipment
- Complete missions within time limits

Visual Style:
- Synthwave color palette (pink, purple, blue neon)
- Low-poly 3D graphics
- Retro-futuristic city design
- Pixel-style UI elements

Mechanics:
- Simple motorcycle handling
- Basic combat (can bump or shoot rival couriers)
- Upgrade system for bike and character
- Mission variety (speed runs, stealth deliveries, etc.)

Technical Feasibility:
- Relatively simple 3D models
- Procedural city generation
- Straightforward physics
- Synth-inspired soundtrack

This concept offers a manageable scope for a solo developer while providing plenty of creative opportunities.
